Name: Luke
Summary: Luke, called the beloved physician, travelled and laboured with Paul, is named in Colossians and Philemon, and was the only companion still with Paul near the end of 2 Timothy. Tradition identifies him as the author of the Gospel of Luke and Acts.
KeyStory: Luke, called the beloved physician, travelled and laboured with Paul, is named in Colossians and Philemon, and was the only companion still with Paul near the end of 2 Timothy. Tradition identifies him as the author of the Gospel of Luke and Acts.
LifeLesson: Staying with a servant of God to the end is a quiet, costly faithfulness.
